headline: Air Products Reports Fiscal 2026 Results and Issues 2027 Guidance
summary: Air Products reported double-digit adjusted EPS growth for fiscal 2026 and announced a reduction in capital spending. The company also secured over $2 billion in new electronics-related project backlogs.
why: Air Products is a major global supplier of industrial gases and chemicals, serving sectors from electronics to energy.
